nav.installIOS: To install Résonance on your phone: tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up), then choose "Add to Home Screen".
nav.installMac: To install Résonance on your Mac: in the "File" menu at the top of the screen, choose "Add to Dock" (or click the Share icon in Safari's toolbar, then "Add to Dock").
nav.installGeneric: To install Résonance: look in your browser's menu for an "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen" option (often a ⊕ icon or a ⋮ menu in the address bar).
nav.shareText: Discover Résonance, independent music, with or without AI, no commission.
nav.shareTrackText: Listen to this track on Résonance!
nav.shareQrHint: Scan to open this page on another phone.
hero.title: Your music, your platform, your rules.
hero.lede: Résonance hosts your tracks, links to your streaming platforms, and lets your audience support you directly. Made solo, with a band, or with the help of AI: your music belongs here.
hero.installNote: 📲 Installable as an app on your phone (button at the top of the page). On iPhone: Share button → "Add to Home Screen", two steps.
how.title: How it works
how.lede: Three steps between your track and your audience.
how.step1.title: Host and stream
how.step1.body: Upload your audio file, add a genre, and it appears instantly in the public catalog, playable right in the browser.
how.step2.title: Get supported
how.step2.body: A support link (Ko-fi, PayPal, Tipeee…) appears on your profile and tracks. Any listener can support you in one click.
how.step3.title: Link your platforms
how.step3.body: Add your Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud or Instagram links: Résonance becomes your central page.

discover.parentalSetPin: Choose a PIN (4+ characters) to lock this filter on this device:
discover.parentalPinTooShort: The PIN must be at least 4 characters.
discover.parentalInfo: Résonance lets you hide tracks flagged as containing explicit language, locked with a PIN only a parent knows. Set it up directly on your child's device. Designed to support families up to France's digital age of consent (15), it's a simple, honest filter, not an identity check.
discover.parentalCaveat: Important for parents: like any online service, Résonance cannot automatically detect a visitor's age, especially since listening requires no account at all. It's up to you to activate this lock, on your child's device: check "Hide explicit content" above, then click "🔒 Lock".
footer.text: Résonance is an independent project. Donation and streaming links lead to the services each artist has chosen.
footer.evolving: Résonance is a French platform that will keep evolving with your feedback. It's a space that welcomes AI-assisted creations while staying within the rules, so artists' work is recognized and paid. Some improvements are already built behind the scenes, like one-click automatic distribution to Spotify and Apple Music, but they're waiting for enough active artists to be switched on.

release.label: Release date (optional)
release.hint: Leave empty to publish right away. Otherwise, your track stays hidden from the public until that date.
release.publishNowHint: Clear this field to publish the track right away.
release.advice.crowded: That's a lot of releases in the same month. Your audience may not keep up: keep a few tracks for the following weeks.
release.advice.spacing: You already have a release less than 2 weeks from this date. Spacing tracks 3 to 6 weeks apart gives each one time to be discovered and shared.
release.advice.short_notice: If you can, allow 1 to 3 weeks to announce the release (cover, snippet, date). And if this track is also going to Spotify, you need at least 7 days to pitch it to their editorial playlists.
release.advice.can_schedule: Tip: you can also schedule the release for a specific date, to have time to announce it first.
release.advice.friday: For reference: in music, new releases traditionally come out on Fridays. It's not required on Résonance.
release.advice.too_far: Releases can be scheduled up to one year in advance.

distguide.title: Getting my music on Spotify and Apple Music
distguide.question: Which service do you use (or want to use) to send your music to Spotify and Apple Music?
distguide.guideIntro: Here's the path we tested from start to finish, step by step, jargon-free.
distguide.otherText: For now, we only have a step-by-step guide for DistroKid, the only service we've been able to test from start to finish. You can of course use another one: your Résonance page doesn't depend on it. Once your track is live, just paste its Spotify or Apple Music link under "Edit" on that track. A question? Write to us: resonance.contact.equipe@proton.me

dist.guideButton: 🎧 Get it on Spotify / Apple Music
distguide.intro: Résonance can't send your music straight to Spotify and Apple Music yet: that button will come later. In the meantime, you go through a distribution service, and we show you how. Once your track is live on Spotify or Apple Music, paste its link under "Edit" on that track: it will appear on your Résonance page.
